$comment: Numerical validation manifest. Each entry names the engine, the reference it is checked against, the tolerance used by the test, and the test that enforces it. tests/validation-manifest.test.mjs checks that every test exists. 'review' is 'self-checked' (by the maintainers, against the reference) until a qualified reviewer signs off using docs/expert-review-checklist.md; no entry is independently reviewed yet.

ngspice-42.name: ngspice
ngspice-42.note: Values recorded from ngspice 42 runs and stored in the tests; opt-in live cross-checks in tests/ngspice.integration.test.mjs

textbook.name: Worked textbook examples cited in the test

entries.tolerance: 5 mV on V(c) after turn-off; 2 mV saturated

test.name: transient restarts with backward Euler at stimulus edges (BJT turn-off matches ngspice)
transient RL current and LC ringing match closed-form results

entries.tolerance: see test assertions (opt-in; skipped unless OPENENTC_NGSPICE is set)

test.name: opt-in built-in solver agrees with ngspice for DC, transient and AC analyses

entries.tolerance: relative 1e-6 on magnitude, 1e-5 rad on phase

test.name: phasor MNA with every dependent source matches ngspice at 1 kHz

entries.tolerance: 1 mV on Vo; 1 mA on peak iL; 5 mV on ripple

test.name: DC-DC converters: CCM against the formulas, DCM buck against ngspice

entries.tolerance: 1 µV on Vout; 1 ps on rise and fall time

test.name: inverter with channel-length modulation agrees with ngspice
inverter VTC matches the long-channel closed forms (λ = 0)
Butterworth and Chebyshev IIR designs match scipy.signal
exact step and impulse responses match scipy.signal
Laplace partial fractions match scipy.signal.residue (simple, repeated and complex poles)
z-transform partial fractions match scipy.signal.residuez; inverse equals the difference equation
Welch PSD equals scipy.signal.welch; EEG states have the expected dominant band
FIR filter block equals scipy firwin + lfilter
convolution, Sobel and median filters equal scipy.ndimage (mode reflect)
Otsu thresholds equal scikit-image; morphology and labels equal scipy
DCT equals scipy dctn(norm=ortho); JPEG quality trades size for PSNR
linear algebra, statistics and polynomials match NumPy
Dijkstra matches scipy and the Kurose–Ross example
digital modulation BER agrees with closed-form theory
controlled rectifiers match the textbook Vdc and Vrms formulas
transformer OC/SC tests reproduce the textbook 20 kVA, 2500/250 V example

entries.tolerance: exact; property test checks equivalence on random functions

test.name: Quine-McCluskey finds the textbook minimal forms
voltage-divider bias: textbook rules, exact Q-point and the circuit simulator agree
the general complex balance reproduces every textbook bridge formula
FFT: Parseval energy, linearity and conjugate symmetry for random real signals
